items.title: Make starter business files opt-in during koala init
items.context: Remove default creation of src/core, src/shells, and business template files from koala init. Add an explicit --starter / --with-template flag that preserves old starter behavior when wanted. Keep bin wrappers, agent assets, docs/story and requirements directories as default Koala management assets.
items.userSees: Default `koala init` output no longer lists `src/core/app.ts`, `src/shells/cli/main.ts`, or `tests/`; `koala init --help` tells users to pass `--starter` or `--with-template` when they want starter business files.

happy.desc: Run default init on a temp project and verify Koala management assets exist while `src/core`, `src/shells`, and `tests` starter assets are absent.

edge.desc: Run default init where `.Codex/agents` already contains stale prompts and verify Koala still refreshes managed Codex assets without creating starter source files.

adversarial.desc: Run init with explicit `--starter` and verify the legacy starter templates are created only in that opt-in mode.

items.title: Detect scanRoot before any optional starter template creation
items.context: Existing-project init should not write scanRoot=src merely because init created src. Compute project type/source-root hints before creating optional starter directories. For Python projects without existing src, scanRoot should remain .; for generic empty starter mode, scanRoot can be src.
items.userSees: In a Python project that has no real `src/` before init, the generated `koala.config.json` shows `language: python` and `scanRoot: .`; starter mode still uses `scanRoot: src` because it intentionally creates the starter source tree.

happy.desc: Run default init in a temp Python project with `requirements.txt` and no `src`; verify no `src` is created and config has `scanRoot` equal to `.`.

edge.desc: Run default init in a project with a pre-existing real `src` directory and verify config can still use `scanRoot: src` without treating Koala-created files as evidence.

adversarial.desc: Run starter init in an empty temp project and verify the intentionally created starter source tree pairs with `scanRoot: src`.

items.title: Cover default and starter init behavior in entrypoint smoke
items.context: Extend scripts/verify-entrypoints.mjs so default koala init does not create src/core/shell templates, and --starter still creates them. Also assert Python project without pre-existing src keeps scanRoot=. after init.
items.userSees: `npm run test:entrypoints` fails if default init recreates starter `src` or `tests`, fails if `--starter` no longer creates the legacy templates, and fails if Python default init writes `scanRoot: src` without a pre-existing `src` directory.

happy.desc: Run `npm run test:entrypoints` after building and see the default-init, starter-init, and Python scanRoot assertions pass.

edge.desc: Inspect the smoke assertions to confirm they check absence of starter directories as well as presence of managed Koala/Codex assets.

adversarial.desc: Break one of the init contracts locally in thought or by reading assertions and confirm the smoke would fail on that regression path.
